messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Paging oncall — repeated GPU OOMs observed on streaming decode pool (us-west-2). Request drops detected. Incident id INC-2026-042. Pager: chris_sre
chris_sre: I'm looking. Node decode-03 showing frequent CUDA OOMs, approx 15 failures in 3m.
sasha_ml: Quick scan of traces — a lot of requests with huge max_tokens (>=50k). Possibly mis-specified header or client loop.
alex_g: Confirming logs: request_id=kjh89 max_tokens=100000 user_agent=partner-app
alex_g: Log snippet:
```
E 2026-03-17T11:12:34Z kernel: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY at decoder.cc:482
GPU0 free: 80MB total: 49152MB
request_id=kjh89 max_tokens=100000
```
jamie_prod: Customer-reported failures inbound: partner-app (acct: partner-42) seeing ~12% error rate since 11:10 PT. maria-custsuccess: I'm on the phone with their SE, they're noticing streaming disconnects and aborted responses.
devops: Proposing immediate mitigations: 1) Drain decode-03 and quarantine. 2) Enforce service-level hard cap max_tokens=2048 at ingress. 3) Reroute traffic to warm pool (decode-01/02) and smaller model variant as fallback.
chris_sre: Doing drain now: `kubectl cordon node/decode-03 && kubectl drain node/decode-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`.
chris_sre: Pushing runtime hotpatch: setting runtime.config.max_tokens_hard=2048 on api-gateway.
alex_g: Hotpatch applied to gateway (deploy 5s). Confirmed header rewrite: X-Max-Tokens > 2048 now capped.
devops: Rerouting 80% of traffic off decode-03 to warm pool. Starting canary 10% to small-decoder-v2 as a safety fallback.
oncall-amber: Taking oncall. Monitoring QPS / error rate. If error rate doesn't drop below 1% in 5m we escalate.
maria-custsuccess: Customer updated: SE acknowledged mitigation, asked for ETA on full fix and root cause.
jamie_prod: Temporary customer message drafted, will send after we stabilize. We need postmortem and timeline.
sasha_ml: Root cause hypothesis: client-side misconfiguration allowed X-Max-Tokens header to be arbitrarily large; server-side enforcement missing in older gateway rollout. Repro steps attached.
```
# repro
curl -H "X-Max-Tokens: 100000" https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/stream
```
chris_sre: Monitoring: OOMs on decode-03 dropped from 15/3m -> 0/3m after cordon + cap. Request error-rate reduced to 0.9% (from 12%).
jamie_prod: Good progress. Action items: 1) Postmortem + RCA (sasha_ml, chris_sre). 2) Gateway hard cap persists until next stable release. 3) Contact partner-42 PM and offer credits/CSAT follow-up (maria-custsuccess). 4) Telemetry alert tweak to detect unusually high max_tokens per request (devops).
alex_g: Follow-up: We'll release fix to validate header parsing and ensure per-tenant quotas enforced by midnight PST.
maria-custsuccess: Customer notified of mitigation; they'll validate tomorrow and report back. Keeping ticket open.
jamie_prod: Closing incident channel for now, moving to paging handoff doc. Will create postmortem thread after RCA. :white_check_mark:
